question: What total aqueous solvation-energy accuracy does the fixed reconstructed-density rho-DROP/CPCM cavity obtain when coupled to the official MACE-POLAR point-l<=1 source, checkpoint-native Exact-GTO receiver, legacy field-energy-plus-PCM ledger, and stock native water SMD-CDS on the historical FreeSolv-12 panel?

can_establish: execution completeness and numerical convergence for the declared energy-only method
MAE, RMSE, mean signed error, maximum absolute error, and threshold counts on the known historical FreeSolv-12 development panel
a method-level comparison with the frozen historical intrinsic-SMD-cavity IEFPCM Exact-GTO diagnostic
cannot_establish: an isolated causal benefit from rho-DROP because the historical comparator also differs in cavity and continuum equation
variationality, analytic forces, optimization, frequency, Hessian, or molecular-dynamics validity
accuracy for ions, nonwater solvents, or chemistry outside the twelve frozen neutral molecules

panel.selection: all locked_records in frozen ordinal order

scientific_identity.solute_source: official MACE-POLAR-1-M atom-centered point multipoles l<=1
scientific_identity.cavity_density: frozen atomic Gaussian reference density minus official MACE-POLAR residual l<=1 density at each SCF iterate

numerical_protocol.required_final_validation: independent exact cold MOIST replay at the converged root followed by a fresh MACE-POLAR response and the same fixed-point gates

reported_metrics: MAE, RMSE, mean signed error, maximum absolute error
per-molecule prediction, signed error, absolute error, energy components, iterations, cold-replay residuals, and wall time
delta MAE and per-molecule error changes relative to the frozen historical Exact-GTO diagnostic

decision_rule.numerical_completion: All 12 records must finish and pass the exact cold-replay fixed-point gate; otherwise retain and report every failure without an accuracy-pass claim.
decision_rule.accuracy_retention: Full-panel MAE must remain below 1.0 kcal/mol.
decision_rule.meaningful_accuracy_improvement: Relative to the historical Exact-GTO MAE of 0.7895271292049749 kcal/mol, MAE must decrease by at least 0.1 kcal/mol, the maximum absolute error must not increase, and the count below 1.0 kcal/mol must not decrease.
decision_rule.negative_or_null_result: If the improvement rule fails, preserve the result and do not retune n_iso, dielectric, source, receiver, ledger, CDS, or cavity parameters on this panel.

workspace.note: The source tree contains intentional uncommitted rho-DROP/Exact-GTO research changes; scientific identity is therefore bound by per-file hashes rather than a clean-tree claim.
